title: Update ESLint to 10.7.0
summary: Update the root WebView lint dependency from ESLint 9 to the current ESLint 10.7.0 release through npm resolution.
reason: A direct compatibility run proved ESLint 10 against the complete WebView prework suite. Dependabot PR #35's red jobs were stale generated package-summary evidence and an unrelated browser navigation timeout, not lint incompatibility.
behavior_before: The root lockfile selected ESLint 9.39.4 and allowed the 9.x range.
behavior_after: The root lockfile selects ESLint 10.7.0. Root npm tooling declares and enforces Node ^22.18.0 || >=24.11.0, the aggregate floor imposed by Babel 8. Standalone browser smokes retain their separately scoped Node 18 capability floor. @eslint/js remains locked at 9.39.4 pending a separate finding-by-finding recommended-config migration.
manual_validation: PASS: npm install resolved ESLint 10.7.0 and npm audit reported zero vulnerabilities.
PASS: npm 11.12.1 reported project engine-strict=true and generated the root package-lock engines.node value from package.json; npm ci completed on Node 24.15.0.
PASS: complete npm run webview:prework:check with ESLint 10.7.0.
PASS: WebView lint budget reported 1,397 warnings against the unchanged 1,402 ceiling and zero errors.
PASS: all generated WebView map, contract, DOM, route, command-boundary, and script-order checks.
EXPECTED DEFERRAL: a controlled ESLint 10.7.0 plus @eslint/js 10.0.1 run produced 102 newly enforced errors: 100 no-useless-assignment and two preserve-caught-error.
rollback_plan: Use npm to restore the ESLint 9 range and lock graph, then rerun npm audit and the complete WebView prework suite.
notes: npm produced all package-lock changes. @eslint/js 10.0.1 is intentionally deferred because its recommended configuration introduces 102 actionable findings requiring a separate reviewable major migration. No rule, ignore, warning budget, test, or gate was weakened. Current @eslint/js 9.39.4 remains operationally compatible with ESLint 10.7.0.
